name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Limited
summary: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Limited designs, manufactures, builds, and services products and systems for electricity distribution in India and internationally. The company offers air-insulated switchgear, e-house and switchyard solutions, vacuum circuit breakers and protection relays, ring main units, gas-insulated switchgear, oil and dry type transformers, automation platforms and digital energy management systems, and battery energy storage solutions.
